idea-plugin.name: Lottie View
idea-plugin.description:
Preview .lottie and Lottie JSON animations directly inside the IDE — like images.

  • Opens .lottie (dotLottie) packages in a preview tab automatically
  • Lottie .json files show a preview alongside the text editor
  • Play, pause, and restart controls
  • Embedded images inside .lottie packages are rendered
  • Runs fully offline in an embedded Chromium (JCEF) panel
Free and open source (MIT) — github.com/tayari24/Lottie-View
